parameters.name: Lang
parameters.description: The language of the content within the request and response.

parameters.name: Limit
parameters.description: The maximum number of top entries to return. The default value is 200. Valid values: 1 to 500.

parameters.name: NatGatewayId
parameters.description: The ID of the NAT Gateway.

parameters.name: SrcPrivateIP
parameters.description: The private IP address of the NAT Gateway.

parameters.name: SrcPublicIP
parameters.description: The public IP address of the NAT Gateway.

parameters.name: TrafficTime
parameters.description: The point in time to query the traffic data. This is a UNIX timestamp. Unit: seconds.
